name: Freedom Force
description: Freedom Force is a singleplayer and multiplayer real-time tactics role-playing game and the first in the Freedom Force series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Freedom Force's configuration.

audio_settings.title: Enable stereo sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Freedom Force's mixer to stereo sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphones
audio_settings.reason: Sets Freedom Force's mixer to headphones.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Freedom Force's mixer to Pro Logic surround sound.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Freedom Force's mixer to 4.0 surround sound.
